result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but the bottom tab bar is visually obstructed by the system navigation/gesture bar, and a few low-contrast/small-text elements may be hard to read. Horizontal card clipping appears consistent with scrollable carousels rather than a defect.

issues.description: The bottom app navigation icons are overlapped by a thick black system navigation/gesture bar, partially striking through the search and cart icons and making the tab bar look broken.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom inset/safe-area padding and edge-to-edge handling so the app tab bar sits above the system navigation area without overlap.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and time ranges uses small gray text that may be difficult to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size and/or contrast for metadata text to meet WCAG contrast guidance.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons on restaurant cards appear to be icon-only controls with no visible label.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites' and ensure focus/touch targets are at least 44dp.
